TDR Portfolio of Expected Results for 2020-2021 
 
 
 
Approach to ensure quality: scientific working group review, extensive internal TDR and RO input. Use 
standardised templates for call for proposals, reviews and follow ups.  
Significant risk 1:  Insufficient managerial and technical staff at the regional office 
Actions to mitigate:  Possibility of outsourcing some of the responsibilities to the regional training centre or 
other institution in the region or engaging fellows from other RCS initiatives  
Significant risk 2:  Instability and inconsistency of regional focal points 
Actions to mitigate:  Ensure broader engagement of other staff in regional offices and support and buy- in from 
appropriate directors in each regional office 
Estimated leverage description: Staff time in regional offices and possible matching funds. 
Estimated 2020-21 (US$)   250,000
